changed.title: Some AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 5 gates represents one of two named 5 by 5 graphs (masks 16235582, 16236078) on the one-a-side promise
changed.statement:
∃ M ∈ ([16235582, 16236078] : List ℕ), ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 5 ∧
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun u v : Fin 5 => M.testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) C
changed.unlocks: whether a NOT gate can save more than 2n - 5 gates on the one-a-side promise at side 5, on the two graphs the read-once count leaves open; a met step breaks the 2n - 5 pair there.
changed.context: No witness is known to us; this is a search; two NOT gates or an input read twice are possible here. Give a gate list of at most 5 AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in two for one of the two masks, judged by evaluation on the 25 promise inputs. Each graph needs at least 11 gates without NOT gates (checked floors: the 'at most 10 AND/OR' rows read refuted). The other twenty masks of the first break step are covered by a separate 'none exists' form. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

changed.title: Some 10-gate AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit of the 7-cycle function reads x_0 only through OR(x_0, h) under an AND, h true where x_0, x_1, x_6 are false
changed.statement: ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (i k : Fin C.gates.length) (h : ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size = 10 ∧ (∀ x : Fin 7 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = ((x 0 && x 1) || (x 1 && x 2) || (x 2 && x 3) || (x 3 && x 4) || (x 4 && x 5) || (x 5 && x 6) || (x 6 && x 0))) ∧ 0 ∈ (C.gates.get i).inputs ∧ (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length, 0 ∈ (C.gates.get j).inputs → j = i) ∧ (C.gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ (C.gates.get k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ i.val < k.val ∧ 7 + i.val ∈ (C.gates.get k).inputs ∧ h ∈ (C.gates.get i).inputs ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ h < 7 + i.val ∧ ∃ x : Fin 7 → Bool, x 0 = false ∧ x 1 = false ∧ x 6 = false ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD h false = true
changed.unlocks: whether the second input of a lone OR reader always implies the OR of the vertex's two neighbours at the open shape
changed.context: Answer with a circuit (gate list and output wire), checked by evaluation on the 128 inputs. Ten gates is the least size for this function (checked), so any witness is a least circuit. What a found circuit shows: the other wire of the OR can be true where both neighbours are false, in a least circuit of a graph with no triangle; on two small graphs WITH a triangle we have such circuits (computed). Tried (computed): on the 5-cycle none; on the 6-cycle no least circuit has the shape; on the 7-cycle one 600 CPU s search gave no verdict. Truth unknown to us.

changed.title: One-a-side promise: the 4 by 6 bipartite graph with mask 1881471 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of at most 9 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 6) => (1881471 : ℕ).testBit (6 * u.val + v.val)) 9
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 6 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 10 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out, equal gates merged and unread gates dropped); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 9; this is a search. Our count of unread rows and columns gives a floor of 8 (on paper), a gap of 2. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 9 right, gate j writes wire 10 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 24 inputs with one vertex on each side.
